title: Enhanced Netherite [Xianziyu]
description: Added a set of stronger Netherite equipment, weapons, and more.
body:
# Mod Description
The Enhanced Netherite mod adds a series of more powerful Netherite equipment to the game.
 

### Corrupt Netherite
 
![腐化](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e8ae3a9f591773aab52cff40dca0a53a2e67271.png)


- Armor: Reduces player health, consumes the Mending enchantment, self-repairs when the player takes damage.
- Weapon: Increases damage and Looting level based on the Corrupt armor the player is wearing, consumes the Mending enchantment, self-repairs when the player takes damage.
- Tool: Increases Fortune level based on the Corrupt armor the player is wearing, consumes the Mending enchantment, self-repairs when the player takes damage.
 

### Echo Netherite
 
![回响](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5e1ce20f9a845d452385a6f4cb5862d394207a4.png)


- Armor: Reduces Warden damage, regenerates health in the Deep Dark, Soulbound.
- Weapon: Increases damage to the Warden, increased experience gain, Soulbound.
- Tool: Increased experience gain, Soulbound.
 

### Ender Netherite
 
![末影](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1722ebcd84678e7ee9ad917d6f784fbcb9729548.png)


- Armor: Prevents the player from falling into the void, Endermen are always passive.
- Weapon: Increases damage to Endermen, prevents Endermen from teleporting, transfers drops to a bound chest.
- Tool: Transfers drops to a bound chest.
 

### Feather Netherite
 
![羽化](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb39a8aadaa431d6074aa2fc6a268c2b4c26a217.png)


- Armor: Reduces fall damage, grants immunity to Levitation.
- Weapon: Attracts nearby drops.
- Tool: Attracts nearby drops.
 

### Fire Netherite
 
![火焰](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e1dee98a5e1eca154c965413b94932feb28c932c.png)


- Armor: Grants immunity to fire damage.
- Weapon: Increases damage to burning targets, auto-smelts drops.
- Tool: Auto-smelts drops.
 

### Gold Netherite
 
![镶金](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e4cd7cba6c200a3c62c4af24d512678b72aa8ff.png)


- Armor: Piglin-like mobs become neutral, increases luck.
- Weapon: Increases damage to Piglins, increases Looting level.
- Tool: Increases Fortune level.
 

### Phantom Netherite
 
![幻影](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/942c30c41b8fa37d4b48bad897e51ab1ba6f6af1.png)


- Armor: Increases step height, grants immunity to Phantom damage.
- Weapon: Increases damage to airborne targets and Phantoms, increases reach distance.
- Tool: Increases reach distance.
 

### Poison Netherite
 
![蛛毒](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38b9f0f6a34da74c6f906cf995265dd6de636c2c.png)


- Armor: Grants immunity to Poison, immunity to arthropod damage.
- Weapon: Applies Poison on attack, increases damage to poisoned mobs.
- Tool: Applies Poison on attack.
 

### Water Netherite
 
![水灵](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dbc6536f739f247343373b265edcdf8c234c092d.png)


- Armor: Grants immunity to Mining Fatigue, increases swim speed, infinite oxygen.
- Weapon: Increases damage to non-burning targets, increases damage to Endermen.
- Tool: Increases underwater mining speed.
 

### Wither Netherite
 
![凋零](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c6846f2d1003a3b6e54e00cee6b8c28fff8cac3.png)


- Armor: Grants immunity to the Wither effect, reduces damage from undead mobs.
- Weapon: Applies Wither effect on attack, increases damage to mobs with the Wither effect.
- Equipment: Applies Wither effect on attack.

## Future Plans:

- Add more tools, such as tridents, bows, shields, etc.
- Add the Ultimate Netherite, which has all the effects of the Enhanced Netherite variants.
- Cross-compatibility with other mods, such as Tetra.
